title: Austin: Development, Airport, & Vital Services
summary:
*   **Development Debate & Rezoning:** The Council addressed significant zoning changes, including a Planned Unit Development on South MoPac and a commercial rezoning on N. Capital of Texas Highway with specific environmental and building conditions. Public concerns were also extensively heard regarding the proposed Windcrest Crossing project.
*   **New Airport Fire Station:** A multi-million dollar contract was approved for constructing a new Airport Rescue and Fire Fighting Station at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport, a key infrastructure investment.
*   **Enhanced Public Safety:** Agreements were finalized to expand Fire and EMS services to newly annexed areas within Travis County.
*   **Utility & Flood Control Projects:** Major investments were authorized for critical wastewater system rehabilitation and a flood control project that involved filing eminent domain proceedings.
